objectives.en: Define differentiation, dedifferentiation and redifferentiation with examples.

narration.en: A young coriander plant and a flowering one have leaves of quite different shapes. A cell can also go back to dividing after it has matured. Plants are remarkably flexible.
narration.kn: ಎಳೆಯ ಕೊತ್ತಂಬರಿ ಗಿಡ ಮತ್ತು ಹೂಬಿಟ್ಟ ಗಿಡದ ಎಲೆಗಳ ಆಕಾರ ಬೇರೆ ಬೇರೆ. ಪಕ್ವವಾದ ಜೀವಕೋಶವೂ ಮತ್ತೆ ವಿಭಜನೆಗೆ ಮರಳಬಲ್ಲದು. ಸಸ್ಯಗಳು ಅದ್ಭುತವಾಗಿ ಹೊಂದಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತವೆ.

body.en: Cells derived from root and shoot apical meristems and cambium differentiate and mature to perform specific functions; this is differentiation. During it, cells undergo major structural changes in their walls and protoplasm. For example, to form a tracheary element the cells lose their protoplasm and develop a very strong, elastic lignocellulosic secondary wall to carry water over long distances. Living differentiated cells that have lost the capacity to divide can regain it under certain conditions; this is dedifferentiation, e.g. the formation of interfascicular cambium and cork cambium from fully differentiated parenchyma cells. The cells produced by such meristems again lose the capacity to divide and mature to perform specific functions; this is redifferentiation.

points.en: Differentiation: tracheary elements lose protoplasm and develop lignified walls.
Dedifferentiation: interfascicular and cork cambium from parenchyma.
Redifferentiation: products of dedifferentiated meristems mature again.
Growth in plants is open and differentiation is also open.

narration.en: Cells derived from root and shoot apical meristems and cambium differentiate and mature to perform specific functions; this is differentiation. During it, cells undergo major structural changes in their walls and protoplasm. For example, to form a tracheary element the cells lose their protoplasm and develop a very strong, elastic lignocellulosic secondary wall to carry water over long distances. Living differentiated cells that have lost the capacity to divide can regain it under certain conditions; this is dedifferentiation, e.g. the formation of interfascicular cambium and cork cambium from fully differentiated parenchyma cells. The cells produced by such meristems again lose the capacity to divide and mature to perform specific functions; this is redifferentiation.
narration.kn: ವಿಶೇಷ ಕಾರ್ಯಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಜೀವಕೋಶಗಳು ಪಕ್ವವಾಗುವುದು ವಿಭೇದನ. ವಿಭಜನಾ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ ಕಳೆದುಕೊಂಡ ಜೀವಕೋಶ ಅದನ್ನು ಮರಳಿ ಪಡೆಯುವುದು ನಿರ್ವಿಭೇದನ; ಉದಾ: ಕಾರ್ಕ್ ಕ್ಯಾಂಬಿಯಂ. ಅವು ಮತ್ತೆ ಪಕ್ವವಾಗುವುದು ಪುನರ್ವಿಭೇದನ.

body.en: Development is the sequence of events that occur in the life of a cell or an organism from germination of the seed to senescence. Plants follow different pathways in response to the environment or phases of life to form different kinds of structures; this ability is plasticity. Heterophylly is an example: in cotton, coriander and larkspur, the leaves of the juvenile plant differ in shape from those of the mature plant. In buttercup, leaves produced in air differ from those produced in water; here heterophylly is caused by the environment. Development is considered the sum of growth and differentiation, and it is under the control of intrinsic factors (genetic and intracellular, such as plant growth regulators) and extrinsic factors (light, temperature, water, oxygen, nutrition).

points.en: Heterophylly by life phase: cotton, coriander, larkspur.

narration.kn: ಅಭಿವರ್ಧನೆ ಎಂದರೆ ಬೀಜ ಮೊಳಕೆಯಿಂದ ವೃದ್ಧಾಪ್ಯದವರೆಗಿನ ಘಟನೆಗಳ ಸರಣಿ. ಪರಿಸರ ಅಥವಾ ಜೀವನದ ಹಂತಕ್ಕೆ ತಕ್ಕಂತೆ ಬೇರೆ ರಚನೆಗಳನ್ನು ರೂಪಿಸುವ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ ನಮ್ಯತೆ; ಉದಾ: ಹತ್ತಿ, ಕೊತ್ತಂಬರಿ, ಬಟರ್‌ಕಪ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಷಮಪರ್ಣತೆ.

problem.en: Classify each process: (a) a parenchyma cell in the cortex starts dividing to form cork cambium; (b) cells cut off by the cork cambium mature into cork cells; (c) a cambial derivative becomes a vessel element with a lignified wall.

steps.en: (a) A mature cell regaining the capacity to divide: dedifferentiation.
(b) Cells from a dedifferentiated meristem maturing for a specific function: redifferentiation.
(c) A meristem-derived cell maturing and losing its protoplasm: differentiation.

narration.en: Let us work through this together. Classify each process: (a) a parenchyma cell in the cortex starts dividing to form cork cambium; (b) cells cut off by the cork cambium mature into cork cells; (c) a cambial derivative becomes a vessel element with a lignified wall.
Class quiz. Discuss, raise hands, and the monitor taps the class answer.
narration.kn: ತರಗತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ಕೈ ಎತ್ತಿ, ಮಾನಿಟರ್ ತರಗತಿಯ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಲಿ.

narration.en: Now two questions in the KCET and NEET pattern. Read every option before you choose.

points.en: Differentiation: cells mature for specific functions.
Dedifferentiation: mature cells regain division (cork cambium); redifferentiation: they mature again.
points.kn: ನಿರ್ವಿಭೇದನ: ಮತ್ತೆ ವಿಭಜನೆ; ಪುನರ್ವಿಭೇದನ: ಮತ್ತೆ ಪಕ್ವತೆ.

points.en: Plasticity: heterophylly in cotton, coriander, larkspur, buttercup.

homework.en: Write one example each of differentiation, dedifferentiation and redifferentiation from plant tissues.

narration.en: Recap. Differentiation: cells mature for specific functions. Dedifferentiation: mature cells regain division (cork cambium); redifferentiation: they mature again. Development = growth + differentiation. Plasticity: heterophylly in cotton, coriander, larkspur, buttercup.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ವಿಭೇದನ: ವಿಶೇಷ ಕಾರ್ಯಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಜೀವಕೋಶಗಳ ಪಕ್ವತೆ. ನಿರ್ವಿಭೇದನ: ಮತ್ತೆ ವಿಭಜನೆ; ಪುನರ್ವಿಭೇದನ: ಮತ್ತೆ ಪಕ್ವತೆ. ಅಭಿವರ್ಧನೆ = ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ + ವಿಭೇದನ. ನಮ್ಯತೆ: ಹತ್ತಿ, ಕೊತ್ತಂಬರಿ, ಬಟರ್‌ಕಪ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಷಮಪರ್ಣತೆ.
